added.summary: Attach an entity to an animated node, including non-joint glTF socket helpers. Parent selects the skeleton, node indexes Animation.nodes (not skin.joints), and Transform remains the bone-local offset. Attachments and descendants follow the final pose after IK, interpolate with the skin, survive snapshot/restore, and place lights, audio and kinematic colliders at the socket on both hosts. Dynamic rigid bodies under a socket are refused.
